'''The Barrows''' was the name for the most dilapidated parts of [[Livien Magnus]]' [[Residential District (Ord Radama)|Residential District]]. It was the only part of the [[city]] to survive its [[Battle of Ord Radama|destruction]] in [[3653 BBY]], and was home to the city's poorest residents.<ref name="OaA1" />
